A pared-down minimalist ggplot2 theme for ggplotpq

Source: R/theme_pq_minimal.R
theme_pq_minimal.Rd

A minimalist ggplot2 theme that mirrors the look of theme_idest() but with no font customisation, no light/dark toggles, and no grid/axis/ticks switches. It is intended as a sensible default theme that does not require the user to have any specific fonts installed.

For more control over fonts, grid lines, axis lines and ticks, use theme_idest() instead.

Usage

theme_pq_minimal(
  base_size = 11,
  base_family = "",
  plot_title_size = 14,
  axis_title_size = 11
)

Arguments

base_size

(numeric, default 11) Base font size.

base_family

(character, default "") Base font family. Empty string means use the system default sans-serif family.

plot_title_size

(numeric, default 14) Font size for the plot title.

axis_title_size

(numeric, default 11) Font size for the axis titles.

Value

A ggplot2::theme object.

See also

theme_idest() for a fuller, font-aware theme.

Author

Adrien Taudière

Examples

# \donttest{
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_pq_minimal()

# }
